text_block_list.text:
Everyone is finalizing their preparations 
for the Takarazuka Kinen. Her rivals are 
also getting into peak form, but... of 
course, her analysis has been nothing 
short of flawless.

Cheval Grand showed an impressive 
performance in the Tenno Sho (Spring). But 
Satono Crown has already finished 
analyzing her as well.

No matter who the opponent is, she will 
not lose. Nor will she let her guard down. 
Because what she aims to be is an 
Umamusume who makes the Satono name 
resound across the world.
